string.text: ドクター「モノリスについて君が話したことは正しい。あれは石棺の近くにある研究所が生み出した幻影にすぎない。この情報から考えると、その研究所こそが、ゾーンの真の秘密を解く鍵なのだろう」
モノリスの呼び声が聞こえた。自分のもとへ来いと呼んでいる。そこへ行けば、すべての疑問に答えが得られるはずだ。

Doctor: "So here's the deal. There's a decoder for opening the door which leads to the system which controls the Monolith. The decoder is hidden in a secret stash in Pripyat. I'm giving you the coordinates of its location and the key. You'll take the decoder, find the right door in the sarcophagus, and then... well, and then you'll just have to see for yourself."
You made it after all, stalker. You turned out to be much stronger than we initially thought. Well, the time for us to talk has come. Head towards the signal. We'll be waiting for you.
